scope: Two selected PVS files, including the generic angular kernel, concrete normalized graph example, Lie observation binding, and their loaded Project/required Native dependency closure. Not whole-library replay or verification of floating-point execution/sensor calibration.

native_inputs.identity_encoding: Native NAME, relative SOURCE, SOURCE SHA256, relative PROOF, PROOF SHA256, INPUT-KIND; duplicate actual occurrences retained.
native_inputs.identity_digest_encoding: SHA256 of UTF8 compact JSON rows above, sorted by compact JSON row encoding; ensure_ascii=false; separators comma,colon.
native_inputs.metadata_scope: The published compatibility bundle changes 130 metadata slots across 44 files (STRING to symbol). Source statements and proof programs are unchanged; the installed NASAlib was not modified.

algorithm.coordinates: Ten real coordinates per vertex under one fixed coordinate map.
algorithm.cutoff: Exact rational 1/10^10; binary64 rounding and control-flow agreement are outside this proof.
algorithm.curvature: Mean acos(clipped consecutive unit-step dot product)/current-step norm, using actual walk vertices; current-inactive and insufficient-data raw branches return 0.
algorithm.certificate: Actual pp_path, at least three samples, every step above cutoff, and computed curvature within the supplied bound.
algorithm.preservation: Same walk and fixed coordinate map under a pp_transform; no bound on every newly admitted path.
algorithm.counterexamples: Straight and orthogonal traces with three normalized samples; forged zero report rejected for bent trace; absent edge rejects certification for any curvature bound.

reproduction.library_setup: Apply scripts/apply_library_proof_fixes.py --nasalib-root <pinned-NASAlib> --apply, and set PVS_LIBRARY_PATH to that checkout plus the PVS installation lib.
reproduction.note: The recorded run selects both entrypoints in one unchanged public run_worker session. Each single-file command also replays its loaded Project and required Native dependencies.
